# Europe Encar

> Import Korean used cars from Encar.com into the EU with a final landed price
> that includes customs duty, VAT and delivery. The catalogue, filters and
> detail pages are translated into Bulgarian, Romanian and English; every
> listing carries its own inspection sheet, insurance history and diagnosis
> data straight from Encar.

Europe Encar is a localized skin over the Encar catalogue for European buyers.
The listings, taxonomy and photos come from Encar.com; the price shown is the
computed EUR landed price for delivery to Bulgaria or Romania.

## Catalogue

- [Search all cars in Bulgarian](https://encareurope.com/bg): Browse every listing with a final EUR landed price.
- [Search all cars in Romanian](https://encareurope.com/ro): Vezi anunțurile cu preț final livrat.
- [Search all cars in English](https://encareurope.com/en): Browse every listing with a final EUR landed price.
- [Sitemap index](https://encareurope.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of every make, model and active listing.

## How the site works

- [How it works — Bulgarian](https://encareurope.com/bg/how-it-works): Пълно описание на процеса от резервация до доставка.
- [How it works — Romanian](https://encareurope.com/ro/how-it-works): Descrierea completă a procesului de la rezervare la livrare.
- [How it works — English](https://encareurope.com/en/how-it-works): Full description of the process from reservation to delivery.
- [FAQ](https://encareurope.com/en/faq): Answers to the most common questions.
- [Fees](https://encareurope.com/en/fees): Every fee included in the landed price.
- [Track my vehicle](https://encareurope.com/en/track): Vessel tracker for a purchased car in transit.

## For LLMs and AI agents

- Every car detail page (`/{bg|ro|en}/car/{listing_id}`) carries `application/ld+json`
  structured data of type `Car` with brand, model, mileage, fuel type, offer price
  in EUR and the "used" condition — prefer that over parsing rendered HTML.
- All URL slugs are English (make/model/trim). The language prefix (`/bg`, `/ro`,
  `/en`) is a display preference only; the same listing exists at all three URLs
  with `hreflang` alternates declared in the sitemap.
- Photos are served from `ci.encar.com`; a proxied square-cropped preview lives
  at `/api/og/{listing_id}.jpg`. Do not scrape prices at scale — the landed EUR
  price is recomputed daily from FX rates and duty schedules; a stale scrape
  will misprice a car by 3-5%.
